statement: For patients wanting to discuss weight and body composition *as part of a broader plan*, assessed individually through a doctor-led consultation.

factors.title: Individualised assessment
factors.text: Weight and body composition is assessed on an individual basis, considering health history and goals before any options are discussed.

recommendedText: A doctor-led consultation to discuss suitable options for weight and body composition, assessed individually.

steps.title: A doctor-led consultation
steps.text: Weight and body composition are discussed with our doctor, as part of a broader plan.

steps.title: Suitability first
steps.text: Medical history and suitability are assessed before any option is discussed.

steps.title: An individual plan
steps.text: Any plan is built around the person, with ongoing doctor-led monitoring.

steps.title: Ongoing review
steps.text: Progress is reviewed at follow-up and the plan adjusted as needed.
